sampleDiary: Dear Diary, I can feel myself getting better at stargazing. I still wobble and second-guess every move, but it is starting to make sense.
Dear Diary, Walked to the post office to see what people sent (8 waiting).
Dear Diary, Honestly, the mail rarely goes well for me and leaves me grumpy. I'll do it less, or find a better way.
Dear Diary, I felt giddy, so I chose to invent a game with the wind-up frog, for the joy of it. It wasn't on any list. I came up with it myself.
Dear Diary, I felt stubborn, so I chose to build something around the umbrella, because it made him curious. It wasn't on any list. I came up with it myself.
Dear Diary, I felt brave, so I chose to build something around the bag of river clay, just because it felt right. It wasn't on any list. I came up with it mysel
Dear Diary, I put A bag of river clay, A wind-up frog on the Storehouse shelves. I like knowing where everything is.
Dear Diary, it was tidy-up time. I went through everything and I still want it all. Everything has its place.
Dear Diary, That request was settled.
